name: Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on media freedom and rule of law in the Czech Republic: threats to the independence of public broadcasters
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position and asking the Czech government to keep Czech public television and radio independent. It wants their funding kept stable and free from political control, and it wants the prime minister to settle a conflict of interest over his business and media holdings. It also asks the European Commission to watch the Czech legislative process and report back.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only calls for action; Czech laws stay as they are.
- **Who it affects:** Czech Television, Czech Radio, the Czech government and the European Commission.
- **What happens next:** The Commission is asked to monitor Czech laws and report back to Parliament.
